tool.name: ScopeKeeper
tool.description: Manage Microsoft DHCP servers: scopes, options, reservations, failover and a full configuration check.
tool.long_description: Alpha – not yet tested against real DHCP servers. Connects to a Microsoft DHCP server (IPv4) with the current account, stored credentials or a different login and keeps the failover partners in view. Every scope opens in its own tab with general settings, address ranges, options, reservations, exclusions, leases and failover state; findings (errors, warnings, best practice) are calculated while you type and mark the affected fields. New scopes are created from a draft or duplicated from an existing scope, with addresses converted to the new network. Changes on failover scopes can be replicated to the partner automatically (works even when the partner is only reachable via RPC, like the DHCP console). Further pages: server options, failover relationships with comparison and raw view, option definitions and a server-wide scan. Requires the RSAT DHCP tools (added automatically during installation).

help.text:
ScopeKeeper – quick help

OVERVIEW
  All scopes with ranges, usage and failover. Double-click opens a scope in its own tab.
  "New scope …" opens a draft, "Duplicate …" copies a scope into a new network.

SCOPE TAB
  General: name, lease duration, state and the address ranges. Gaps between ranges become exclusions when saving.
  Options, reservations, exclusions, leases: changes take effect on the server immediately.
  Findings: errors, warnings, best practice and infos. Double-click applies the suggested fix or jumps to the object.
  A "?" next to a field shows the findings for that field.

FAILOVER
  With auto replication on, a failover scope is transferred to the partner after every change.
  If the partner cannot be reached via WinRM, ScopeKeeper automatically uses RPC (failover API and netsh) – like the DHCP console.
  Server options are never replicated automatically.

CLIPBOARD
  Options, reservations and exclusions can be copied between scopes; addresses are converted on request.

KEYS
  Ctrl+W closes the current tab, Del removes, F2 edits, Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V copy and paste.
